original_context: Any cartoon character with a distinct voice expresses themselves.
Any cartoon character that stands out or has a unique style will get attention.
If a cartoon character breaks conventions and expresses themselves, then they stand out.
Nelson either follows rules or breaks conventions.
If a cartoon character follows rules, they may not necessarily think outside the box, and vice versa.
Any cartoon character who makes people laugh or has imagination can think outside the box.
Nelson either has imagination or is creative, but not both.
If Nelson is creative, then he can either entertain his friends or save the day, but not both.
conclusion: Nelson does not save the day.
